    • readFromFile

      public void readFromFile(String fileName)
      Description copied from interface: Graph
      Replaces the content of the graph with the content of the file. File format: First line - two integers separated by space. First V (vertex count) and E (edge count), then V vertex (nonnegative int's), then 2*E pairs "from to" describing each edge.
      Specified by:
      readFromFile in interface Graph
      Parameters:
